encoding.canonical: compact UTF8 JSON, no pretty whitespace; source raw native JSON strings retained byte-exact

encoding.enums: fixed finite numeric maps below, no free-text per event
encoding.invariants: unknown/missing keys, cap violations, invalid UTF8/value widths, per-process sequence gap or overflow invalidate acceptance; never truncate/sample/wrap; retain failure prefix and owned cleanup

actor_contexts.registration: immutable per native lifecycle/token tuple, new context on change; no pointer identities
actor_contexts.types: firstprocref+logicalactorref0..3, sevenopaqueu64decimal, actualrace/class/deity/zoneu32, finitecontext_kindu8, actuallevelu8; complete encoded entry including separator <=256

5_publication.boundary: AFTER successful atomic write/file+directory sync, actual serialized bytes hash; never report failed write as committed

6_attack_decision.counting: 256 COMBINED all actor-involved native authorization/denial decisions, outgoing AND incoming retaliation. Every observed gate entry/attempt counts, including nested duplicate entry decisions; no hidden fanout, no dedup to evade cap, no predicate polls. Overrun stops/invalidates, not changes gameplay.
6_attack_decision.boundary: actual serialized native authorization/denial decision and truthful HP, including incoming retaliation; all recorded nested gate entries count; no predicate polling

7_native_faction_delta.boundary: same native computed delta, <=5 per actual credited kill

8_death_award_credit.padding: All zero_u64 values are string zero. Native actual level belongs to context+level events. Same native deltas refer award_ref; credit binds actual committed record revision/hash.

9_level_ack.boundary: native level application plus later actual native/Rust acknowledgement, not saved level alone

10_resolved_reaction.boundary: same result from real evaluator/gate, no duplicate formula or extra award calculation; reaction transitions plus each attack decision carry con

11_body_ready_custody.boundary: actual entity membership/drain(!runtime_alive&&!body), readiness token binding; successful Rust intent/publication/acquire/release in causal order

12_command_fault_barrier.boundary: expected killed process needs observed complete flushed prefix plus independent process-start/reap identity; unseen tail is a gap, not invented native release

snapshots.consistency: clean stopped fixture barrier or verified stable revisions; mixed revisions invalid; no actor lock acquisition or observation
snapshots.raw_handling: opaque byte-exact JSON strings, parse integer-aware only, preserve native number types; hashes refer to original committed record bytes
snapshots.raw_json_by_actor: exact3 opaque original native JSON strings, sumUTF8<=8192; integer-aware parser, Record6keys/Saved16keys/Item23keys all exact; no JS-number conversion

native_callback_constraint: fixed in-memory buffer only; NO Rust call, file I/O, blocking, policy mutation, actor-lock observation or authority changes in callbacks; flush/export outside callback. Overflow invalidates integration result, not permissions/game state.
causality: per-process process-start identity+monotonic sequence, actor owner_epoch/revision, native generation/incarnation/goal/operation and boot/ready transfer token; cross-process proof uses these causal edges, NOT wall timestamps alone
